localAdaptations: Only upstream commit b10a6b66 is taken (merged 30 October 2026 as 26b1de62): at the start of serveInteractive, the --interactive line server, a detached thread polls getppid() once a second and calls _exit(3) with 'ot_emu: parent <pid> is gone: exiting' once the parent changes. The 11 lines apply unchanged to the copy the 5c71bc8c record pinned.

Every other change upstream made to main.cpp since 5c71bc8c (the stall CPU print and its Machine::sr(), frame-stamped .frames files, OT_PROFILE_ALL) is left out, and main.cpp keeps Modwerk's independent scenario block-dump streams and per-child audio-capture flag, so the vendored file is upstream's 5c71bc8c copy with those adaptations plus this hunk, not upstream's file at this revision.
docs/remixer/EMU.md stays the 5c71bc8c copy byte for byte: upstream's README sentence for this change is not taken.
limitations: Emulator only: no builder file, base source, module or package changes, so every image, refusal and package identity of the earlier records holds by identity.
The watcher arms only in --interactive; the batch mode is unchanged. An emulator whose parent is launchd (pid 1) from the start arms no watcher.
